title: Static GK: Bank Note Printing Presses & Currency Infrastructure in India
summary: India operates 4 currency printing presses divided equally between RBI and SPMCIL.

blocks.content: India operates 4 currency printing presses divided equally between RBI and SPMCIL.

items: BRBNMPL Presses (RBI Subsidiary): Mysore (Karnataka) and Salboni (West Bengal) established under BRBNMPL (Founded Feb 3, 1995).
SPMCIL Presses (Government of India): Nashik (Maharashtra) and Dewas (Madhya Pradesh) under Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India.
